boards.createText: A board collects one type of feedback.
boards.deleteFailed: The board could not be deleted.
boards.deleteText: The posts of this board leave every list. Posts that were merged into its posts become separate posts again.
boards.emptyText: Create a board to collect feedback.
boards.name: Name
boards.note: Public: everyone. Signed-in: people who sign in to the portal. Team only: your team. Segments: the segments that you choose in the board settings.
boards.renameText: The board address changes to the new name when that address is free.
boards.title: Boards

categories.createText: Tags sort changelog entries by type.
categories.deleteFailed: The tag could not be deleted.
categories.deleteText: Changelog entries lose this tag. You cannot undo this.
categories.emptyText: Create a tag to sort changelog entries.
categories.name: Name
categories.renameText: Changelog entries keep the tag with its new name.
categories.taken: A changelog tag with this name exists.

changelog.description: Publish your product updates on the portal, in the widget and in an RSS feed.
changelog.publicText: Show the changelog on the portal, in the widget and in the RSS feed.
changelog.title: Changelog

feedback.description: Manage the boards and tags of your feedback, and the public roadmap.
feedback.roadmapText: Show the roadmap tab and its pages on the portal.
feedback.title: Feedback

login.created: The new secret is ready. Copy it now.
login.description: Choose how customers sign in to the portal and the widget, and manage the signing secrets.
login.docsNote: Read how to sign people in from your app:
login.methodsText: The portal uses the sign-in methods of this instance. An instance administrator changes them.
login.rotateFailed: The secret could not be changed.
login.rotateText: The old secret stops working at once. Give the new secret to your server.
login.secretText: Your server signs identify tokens with this secret. Keep it private.
login.signupText: Let new people create a portal account.
login.title: Login & SSO
login.tokensText: The widget accepts only identify tokens that your server signs with the widget secret.
login.workspaceIdText: The widget and the API use this ID.

privacy.description: Choose who can see the portal and the board, and who can post.
privacy.domainTooLong: Each domain can have 253 characters or fewer.
privacy.domainsText: People who sign in with an address at one of these domains can open the portal. Put a comma between the domains.
privacy.guestsText: Let visitors post and vote without an account.
privacy.moderateText: Hold new posts for review before they show on the portal.
privacy.signInText: How customers sign in to the portal. They always sign in with an account on this site.
privacy.ssoUrlText: Save it to offer it as the sign-in button. The portal sends people here with a return_to address. Sign the person's token with the widget secret, as for the widget, and redirect to return_to with &token= added.
privacy.ssoUrlInvalid: Enter a full address that starts with https://.
privacy.widgetSignIn: Open the portal signed in from the widget
privacy.widgetSignInText: People your app identified in the widget open the portal signed in. This only reaches a portal account that it created for them in this workspace. An email that already has an account uses the sign-in page.
privacy.holdSensitiveText: Send a post or comment that shows an email address, a phone or card number, an IBAN or a secret key to review first. With AI set up, a post's images are checked too, just after it is posted.
privacy.holdSpamText: Send a post or comment that looks like spam (many links, spam phrases, shouting, repetition) to review first.
privacy.title: Privacy & Access
privacy.visibilityText: A private portal shows only to the people that you allow.

scoring.name: Factor {{n}} name
scoring.note: Weights go from -10 to 10. Use a negative weight for a cost, such as effort. A request's score is the sum of weight × its value from 0 to 10, set in Triage. A score ranks requests; it never changes a task.
scoring.title: Scoring factors
scoring.weightRange: Use a whole number from -10 to 10, other than 0.
